temporal_split.filter_order: filter raw position=1 first, then preserve stable source order
temporal_split.boundary_tie_rule: hard fail if the final training timestamp equals the first evaluation timestamp
temporal_split.random_reference_rule: use Random-policy raw-position-1 rows whose timestamps lie inclusively between the first and last BTS evaluation timestamps

forbidden_during_audit: access or conversion of click values
IPS, SNIPS, direct-method, or doubly-robust estimates

identifiability_gate.bts_evaluation_action_support: must equal the complete frozen 46-action catalog
identifiability_gate.random_reference_action_support: must equal the complete frozen 46-action catalog
identifiability_gate.failure_rule: if either support set is incomplete, Study 3 stops before any click outcome is parsed and any redesign requires a new prospective amendment

methodology_after_success.inheritance: After the exact temporal split is frozen, Study 3 will replicate Study 2 methodology unless an explicitly prospective pre-outcome amendment is merged first.
methodology_after_success.reward_model: L2-penalized logistic regression using scikit-learn LogisticRegression, solver=newton-cholesky, C=1, l1_ratio=0, fit_intercept=true, tol=1e-4, max_iter=100, class_weight=null
methodology_after_success.features: same training-only preprocessing and feature construction as Study 2, adapted only to the frozen 46-action women catalog
methodology_after_success.challenger_rule: 0.90 on the action with largest q_hat plus 0.10/46 on every frozen action; exact ties choose the lowest item_id

bootstrap.method: paired moving-block bootstrap over evaluation rows ordered by timestamp

methodology_after_success.promotion_rule: promote only if the lower endpoint of the 95% bootstrap CI for challenger DR minus observed BTS value is > 0 AND challenger ESS/n >= 0.10

next_gate: The exact outcome-blind temporal-audit result must be packaged and merged before Study 3 training is authorized.
outcome_visibility: No click value from the selected women campaign has been parsed or aggregated to create this lock.
